    Our Culture

    Our culture is a cornerstone of what makes IDN what it is today. We strive to be a company with a genuinely good culture that values inclusion and a growth mindset. These principles are embodied in our concept of "Timmyness," which comprises 10 core values that every IDN employee is expected to embrace.
